title: Pidgeot #18 Topps Pokemon TV Animation Edition 1999 Holo Foil Black Logo
descriptionText:
#18 Pidgeot — Holo Foil
1999 Topps Pokémon, TV Animation Edition Series 1
Foil parallel — prismatic holographic finish on both front and back, not the plain base card
Black Topps logo printing
Type: Normal. First appearance: Episode 9, "School of Hard Knocks"
Officially licensed by Nintendo; a Topps trading card, not a Pokémon TCG game card
Condition: Excellent. Light edge wear consistent with a card of this age, as these foils almost always show. No creases, no bends, no writing. Photographed front and back under natural light — what you see is the exact card you receive.
